title: C.H.U.D. II: Bud the C.H.U.D.
review: Like any good sequel to a earnest but clumsy horror movie, with some subtle or unintentional comedy, the sequel ramps the comedy way up and doubles down on what people actually enjoyed about the original. The shining example of the comedic pivot is {The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2}, and as per my expectations the {C.H.U.D.} sequel doesn't come close. It does have some decent jokes though, being a farcical parody of horror tropes, and full of surreal moments almost rivaling {Wet Hot American Summer}. The plot is completely disconnected from the first film, and Bud is just a zombified {E.T.}: a monster the kids have to hide from their parents. The editing and is too slow-paced for a comedy though. About four times as much stuff happens in {Gremlins 2: The New Batch} than in this movie. Some transitional shots are so long that it feels like they were struggling to hit the 84 minute runtime, and it sometimes harms the comic timing. Like {Maniac Cop 2} there's a bespoke theme song with lyrics about the main character. Finally, to make one more comparison, it has the same penchant for blowing shit up for no reason as {Critters}.
